b1.pisces_illusion_at_inn.summary: A frost-and-bone monster forcing the door is an illusion: Erin's thrown pot knocks out Pisces. Under threat of the pot he pays in silver. She feeds him anyway; he names the Floodplains and admits a hobby of necromancy.
